label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Todo reptil del ave el andante sobre cuatro, abominación él a ustedes.
spanish: Todo lo que pulula de lo que vuela el andante sobre cuatro, abominación él a ustedes.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'reptil' with 'lo que pulula' for H8318 שֶׁרֶץ (sourceTokenId h03011020002): matches the packet's AHRC concreteSense SWARMER ('the creature(s) of a large swarm'); 'reptil' added the zoological class Reptilia that the construct noun does not carry, per the auditor's fail finding.

Replaced 'ave' with 'lo que vuela' for H5775 הָעוֹף (sourceTokenId h03011020003): matches the packet's AHRC concreteSense FLYER ('a flying creature such as a bird or insect'); 'ave' narrowed the generic flying-creature noun to the bird class, per the auditor's warn finding.
readerNote: 'Lo que vuela' renders H5775 here per the packet's FLYER sense (bird or insect, not bird only); other verses in this chapter gloss the same lemma as 'ave' where the auditor did not flag narrowing.
